Class Stock

  • java.lang.Object
    • domain.Stock
  • public class Stock
extends java.lang.Object
    The Stock class is an entity class for the stock object. Title : Stock.java

    Description:

    The Stock class is an entity class for the stock object.

    Stock object contains the stock information, can control whether each option is available.
